report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces returned 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200 responses with zero 502s. The only deployment record shows order 1.0.0 with no previous version, which cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No current evidence substantiates a bounded root cause, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (non-2xx or error status) to confirm the alert is real
Deployment history for checkout/inventory/payment services, not only order, with version change timestamps
Metrics for checkout service error rates and status codes over the incident window
Evidence correlating any deployment event in time with observed error onset
